bio.text: Mia Costello, a Republican, has represented District 15 in the Alaska House of Representatives since 2025, after serving in the House from 2011 to 2014 and in the Alaska Senate from 2015 to 2022, according to the Alaska Legislature.

The legislative biography says Costello was born in Anchorage in 1968 and holds a B.A. in government from Harvard University (1990) and a Master of Arts in Teaching from the University of Alaska Southeast (1997).
Before the Legislature, Costello worked as a teacher, a public relations executive and deputy director of communications in the Governor's office.
